subject: general
question:
Select the most suitable expression that can substitute the underlined part of the sentence without any change in meaning.

Planning to go for a movie just before the final-year examination is nothing but __skating on thin ice.__
solution:
The correct answer is ***Option 2)***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"skating on thin ice"** means being in a risky or dangerous situation. (खतरनाक स्थिति में होना)

 
 
• **Example:** By lying to his boss, he was* **skating on thin ice.***
 
 
 
• **"Being in a risky situation"** refers to being in a scenario where there is a high chance of danger or failure. (खतरनाक स्थिति में होना)
 
 
• **Example:** Investing all your money in a single stock is*** being in a risky situation.***
 
 

Therefore, the correct meaning of the given idiom is ***being in a risky situation ***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Doing hard work** (कड़ी मेहनत करना): The act of putting in a lot of effort to achieve something.

 
 
• **Example:** She is ***doing hard work*** to prepare for her exams.
 
 
 
• **Enjoying the moment** (क्षण का आनंद लेना): The act of appreciating or savoring the present time.
 
 
• **Example:** They were ***enjoying the moment*** while watching the sunset.
 
 
 
• **Going to hill stations** (पहाड़ी क्षेत्रों में जाना): The act of traveling to high-altitude areas for leisure or vacation.
 
 
• **Example:** We are planning on ***going to hill stations*** during the summer break.
